evidence_ceiling: No comparative results are claimed. Baselines require a frozen common oracle, candidate set, operating-case set and total evaluation cost.
shared_controls: same initial evidence and candidate set
same design variables, objectives, units and hard constraints
same total budget, including engineering, solver and follow-up validation cost
same high-fidelity or hidden synthetic truth oracle
same failed, aborted, censored and out-of-domain cost accounting

policies.description: select next candidate/method from a preregistered random seed
Latin-hypercube or another frozen space-filling design
deterministic grid/sweep over the same domain
fixed low-to-high sequence with one discipline handoff at a time
evolutionary Pareto search with fixed population/termination budget

policies.assumption: requires calibrated predictive distributions and declared acquisition semantics
requires qualified cross-fidelity correlation and constraint probability semantics

policies.description: select largest predicted uncertainty; control for decision-irrelevant uncertainty

policies.assumption: requires a defensible probabilistic model; entropy reduction alone is not decision value
requires calibrated distributions and an explicit loss/decision model
works with declared uncertainty sets; do not infer probabilities

non_compensable_gates: any false-feasible synthetic case is reported separately and prevents a zero-false-feasible gate
missing required analysis is not a pass
out-of-domain use is not silently extrapolated
hard constraint failures cannot be offset by objective improvements
unknown cost is not treated as zero
